Bilmanka Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zaporizhia Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. This cemetery disappeared gradually rather than through deliberate demolition: locals say the river gradually washed away its tombstones between the 1990s and 2000s, and where they ended up remains unknown. One elderly resident recalled that a road was later built through the site. Most strikingly, residents also described a moment when the river's erosion exposed a woman's body from one of the graves; locals reburied her, though they could no longer point out where. Little else is documented about Bilmanka's Jewish community beyond a prayer house that existed as of 1885.
